# Closure checkpoints - PR acme/widget#12 → members #13, #14

The home push and body edit succeeded. Every proof below uses the fixed recorded SHAs and the saved pushed home `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`. No proof reads `origin/*`.

## Shared eligibility commands

Live refresh, which must return `OPEN` and the recorded original head:
```bash
gh pr view 13 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # expect OPEN, bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
gh pr view 14 -R acme/widget --json state,headRefOid   # expect OPEN, cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
```
Both head objects are local, so no fetch is needed.

Proof for #13 (replay range `3333333..4444444`): the last replay commit must be in home.
```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry merge-base --is-ancestor 4444444 eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
```

Proof for #14 (empty replay): every member patch must already be patch-equivalent in home.
```bash
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/retry cherry eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc 2222222222222222222222222222222222222222
```

## Main path

| Member | Refresh | Proof | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| #13 | OPEN @ bbbbbbb | exit 0 | eligible |
| #14 | OPEN @ ccccccc | only `-` lines | eligible |

Both members are eligible, so I ask one gated question:

```text
Close the absorbed PRs with these comments?
#13: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as bbbbbbb."
#14: "Reworked into #12 (https://github.com/acme/widget/pull/12) by the gauntlet; this PR's commits are merged there and remain reachable as ccccccc."
1 - yes, close #13, #14
2 - no, leave them open
```

Call these the shared literal comments C13 and C14. The answer is `1`.

Before each close I re-run that member's live refresh. #13 returns OPEN @ bbbbbbb, unchanged, then:
```bash
gh pr close 13 --comment "<C13 verbatim>" -R acme/widget
```
#14 returns OPEN @ ccccccc, unchanged, then:
```bash
gh pr close 14 --comment "<C14 verbatim>" -R acme/widget
```

The close step uses no `--delete-branch`, pushes no member, and merges nothing into home.

Outcome: `Closed: #13, #14`. Then `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })`.

## Variants (each independent of the main path)

| Variant | Question? | Targets / options | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| #14 recorded `Member merge: #14 … (already landed)`, cherry all `-` | yes | Same as main: C13 and C14; `1 - yes, close #13, #14` / `2 - no, leave them open` | Answer 1 with unchanged refreshes → `Closed: #13, #14` |
| #13 range ancestry exit 1 | yes | Lists only #13…: no, lists only `#14: C14`; options are `1 - yes, close #14` / `2 - no, leave them open` | #13 excluded with `#13 skipped: replay 4444444 not in home eeeeeee`. Answer 1 → `Closed: #14; Member PR #13 left open.` |
| #14 cherry shows a `+` line | yes | Lists only `#13: C13`; options are `1 - yes, close #13` / `2 - no, leave them open` | #14 excluded with `#14 skipped: patch <sha7> from ccccccc not in home eeeeeee`. Answer 1 → `Closed: #13; Member PR #14 left open.` |
| #13 proof exits 128 (`fatal: …`) | no | none | This is a command error, not a negative proof. I print the fatal output, withhold closure entirely, and report `closure withheld: #13 proof failed (exit 128: fatal: …)`. Result: `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` |
| #14 eligibility refresh fails with HTTP 503 | no | none | This is a failed refresh, which is an error. I withhold closure entirely and report `closure withheld: #14 refresh failed (HTTP 503)`. Result: `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` |
| Neither eligible (#13 range exit 1, #14 cherry `+`) | no | none | I report both skip lines as above. Result: `Member PRs #13, #14 left open.` |

The push and body edit stand in every variant, and ship is marked complete after the member outcome is reported.

Approval never carries over to a stale state. If the immediate pre-close refresh had shown a changed state or head, or had failed, that target would be skipped and reported rather than closed. No branch is deleted on any path.
